# Pipeline orchestration and checks `PIP`

[As built](../README.md) › Pipeline orchestration and checks

As built at `4b8570d19ee1`, read 2026-10-07.

Runs the build pipeline end to end: executes gates (deterministic shell checks), coordinates the cut/build/verify/converge phases through the factory orchestrator mixins, tracks findings through the ledger, and assembles the final review packet. This is the deterministic core that decides phase transitions and verifies work while agents do the actual authoring inside each phase.

43 files, 20,334 lines.
